concerns.text: T012 mandates downloading raw fMRI data from OpenNeuro/HCP. This violates FR-011 and the Constitution (Principle III) which require the system to verify CAQ availability *before* execution and halt if missing. Downloading raw data (which is large) before validating the existence of the specific behavioral proxy (CAQ) in the manifest risks wasting resources and violates the 'fail fast' constraint of FR-011. The task order must be reversed: validation (T033) must precede any data fetching.

T017 requires reporting the Pearson correlation coefficient. However, FR-006 and US-3 explicitly mandate that significance testing be performed via 10,000 permutation tests to derive an *empirical* p-value. T017 implies a standard parametric correlation calculation without explicitly mandating the permutation-based p-value required by FR-006. This risks delivering a parametric p-value which violates the statistical validation protocol (Constitution Principle VII) and FR-006.

T046 implements the sensitivity sweep but does not explicitly mandate that the p-values reported for each window length be the *permutation-derived* empirical p-values (from FR-006). The spec (US-3) requires the sensitivity table to report how the 'permutation p-value' varies. T046's description only mentions 'compute correlation and p-value', which could be interpreted as a parametric p-value, violating the requirement for permutation-based significance in the sensitivity analysis.

T060 requires profiling to ensure the pipeline completes within 6 hours on a subset of 10 subjects. However, the Spec Assumptions and Constitution (Principle VII) assume a scale of ~1000 participants. Profiling only 10 subjects does not verify the constraint for the full dataset, creating a silent relaxation of the performance requirement. The task must include a scaling projection or a test on a representative larger subset to satisfy the 6-hour constraint for the full study scope.

T051 implements the regression model but does not explicitly include a step to verify that the `static_connectivity_strength` values (calculated per participant in T014.1) are correctly aligned with the filtered participant lists from T018/T019. If data exclusion (motion/missing scores) occurs after static strength calculation, the vectors may desynchronize. The spec (FR-005) requires a valid regression; silent misalignment violates the data integrity requirement.
